root_cause: validate-round workflow uses actions/checkout@v4 with default fetch-depth=1 (shallow clone). In a shallow clone of a no-ff merge commit, git rev-list --parents -n 1 HEAD (called by check_commit_message.py:is_merge_commit()) may behave differently than in a full clone. The script may not recognize the merge commit, fall through to the round_id-in-message check, and FAIL because the auto-generated merge message does not contain the PRE_R049 required token. validate-canonical-repair workflow uses fetch-depth: 0 (full clone) and succeeds on the same commit because git commands have full history available.
